 Union Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya to inaugurate 74th Foundation Day of EPFO in New Delhi 
 News On AIR | 
 November 1, 2026 8:21 AM 
 Union Minister Dr Mansukh Mandaviya to inaugurate 74th Foundation Day of EPFO in New Delhi
 Union Minister for Labour and Employment Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya will inaugurate the 74th Foundation Day of Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) in New Delhi today. During the event, Dr. Mandaviya will launch key EPFO initiatives, including the Automatic Settlement of Eligible Inoperative Employees’ Provident Fund Accounts with balances up to one thousand rupees and EPFO Services through WhatsApp, among others.
The Ministry of Labour and Employment said that the Minister will also review exhibition stalls at the venue and release a series of publications reflecting EPFO’s commitment to knowledge creation, institutional learning, legal awareness and compassionate governance. Dr. Mandaviya will also present the Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 to recognise outstanding contributions by Regional Offices, Zonal Offices, individual officers and employees.
